characteristic.claim_under_review: The immutable characteristic specification completely defines the supplied integer objects, all-prime certificates, concrete diagrams, controls, costs and later lifecycle for bounded implementation consideration. No scientific finding is under acceptance.
characteristic.coordinator_prior: The most consequential risks are changing the integral presentation after quotient or specialization, treating a selected-minor prime set as exact, confusing the free integral kernel with cokernel torsion, and omitting complete map or checking cost. The explicit finite definitions may support a complete protocol, but no theorem, runtime or scientific readiness is assumed before independent review.

joints.joint: C1 literal integral models, weights and commuting maps
joints.attack_plan: Read the literal g1/g2 coefficient lists and all ordinary/normal bases, q,j,L,rho,iota definitions and fixed weights. Manually trace the D=2 split and the free-u/bit-u witness. Try dropping a zero column, changing a generator weight after reduction, or adding u^p-u, and identify exactly which stated object or map changes. Keep geometric exclusions separate from integer rank exceptions.
joints.breaking_artifact: A specific missing basis coordinate, incorrect map/domain, silent presentation change or unsupported geometric/Boolean transfer.

joints.joint: C2 rank, determinantal, Smith and kernel-basechange completeness
joints.attack_plan: Challenge the rank upper factorization independently of the selected lower minor; track both integer inverse identities in U A V=S, every determinantal divisor, complete factorization and the connecting map Av/p. Apply the claims to [2,3], diag(1,2), nonprimitive free-kernel vectors and prime-power collision pairs. Read the actual primary Fitting/Tor/SNF statements and their ring/orientation assumptions.
joints.breaking_artifact: A conservative set labelled exact, incomplete all-minor argument, unsaturated kernel basis, lost prime-power order or incorrect connecting-map claim.

joints.joint: C3 complete source panel, null feasibility and negative controls
joints.attack_plan: Reconcile all 25 matrix/control units, twelve-candidate feasibility subpanel, fourteen model/degree chain units and 39 reserved RUN mappings. Review all 24 corruption classes and their eligible/empty-case coverage. Distinguish eight fixed-prime checks from exact all-prime certification; try a hash-only rejection that never exercises the intended mathematical predicate.
joints.breaking_artifact: An omitted unit, infeasible null silently replaced, wrong denominator, unexercised inner predicate or finite-prime sampling used as an all-prime proof.

joints.joint: C4 complete costs and concrete formal scope
joints.attack_plan: Follow every construction, unsuccessful search, factorization, basis-map, witness-growth and independent-checking cost through the five arms. Check the Lean target against the literal D=2 coordinate formulas and counterexample, preserving its D=2 ceiling and all remaining D=0..6 obligations. Challenge any abstract assumed-premise or smoke theorem presented as the concrete target.
joints.breaking_artifact: An omitted cost or resource unit, uncontrolled reuse, weakened formal statement, fabricated pin/proof or extrapolation beyond its declared finite scope.
